text: Guides users through creating an account and deploying their first GPU to run code remotely
quote: Follow this guide to learn how to create an account, deploy your first GPU, and use it to execute code remotely.

text: Public Endpoints give instant API access to pre-deployed image/video/audio/text AI models with no infrastructure setup
quote: Runpod offers Public Endpoints for instant API access to pre-deployed AI models for image, video, audio, and text generation. No deployment or infrastructure required

text: Provides two official MCP servers that connect AI tools and coding agents directly to Runpod
quote: Runpod provides two Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect AI tools and coding agents directly to Runpod

text: Instant Clusters offer fully managed multi-node compute with high-performance networking for distributed workloads
quote: Instant Clusters provide fully managed multi-node compute with high-performance networking for distributed workloads.

text: Open-source CLI lets you manage Pods, Serverless endpoints, templates, volumes and models from your local machine

text: SSH gives secure, reliable full shell access to a running Pod for long-running processes
quote: SSH provides secure, reliable access to your Pod for long-running processes and full shell capabilities.

text: S3-compatible API lets you manage files on network volumes without launching a Pod
quote: Runpod provides an S3-protocol compatible API for direct access to your network volumes. This allows you to manage files on your network volumes without launching a Pod

text: REST API v1 gives programmatic access to all Runpod compute resources for integration into apps and automation
quote: The Runpod REST API v1 provides programmatic access to all Runpod compute resources. Integrate GPU infrastructure into your applications, workflows, and automation systems.

text: Coding agents can auto-migrate to REST API v1 by running a migrate skill command after installing the skills plugin
quote: To migrate automatically, ask your coding agent to run `/runpod:migrate rest` once you've installed the Runpod skills plugin.

text: Pre-built templates (e.g. PyTorch) skip manual dependency/environment setup and launch ready-to-go instantly
quote: Instead of installing PyTorch, configuring JupyterLab, and setting up dependencies yourself, you can select a template and have everything ready instantly.

text: Committing to a 3- or 6-month term unlocks significant discounts on compute costs
quote: Commit to a 3-month or 6-month term upfront for significant discounts on compute costs.

text: Agents can create Pods, deploy Serverless endpoints, transfer files, or deploy code via natural-language instructions
quote: Once installed, you can ask your agent to create Pods, deploy Serverless endpoints, transfer files, or deploy your own code with Flash, all in natural language.

text: Auto-pay automatically reloads account balance below a threshold to avoid service interruptions
quote: Auto-pay automatically reloads your account balance when it falls below a threshold, helping you avoid service interruptions from low funds.

text: Deployed Pods can be accessed via SSH, web proxy, JupyterLab, or VS Code/Cursor for different workflows
quote: Once deployed, you can connect to your Pod through SSH for command-line access, web proxy for exposed web services, JupyterLab for data science workflows, or VS Code/Cursor for local IDE integration.

text: CLI lets you run Python functions on remote GPUs directly from your local terminal
quote: Run Python functions on remote GPUs directly from your local terminal.

text: Network volumes provide persistent storage that survives Pod termination or scale-to-zero
quote: Network volumes provide persistent storage that exists independently of your compute resources. Data is retained when terminate or scale to zero.

text: Serverless is billed pay-per-second with no upfront cost, from worker start until it fully stops
quote: Serverless offers pay-per-second pricing with no upfront costs. You're billed from when a worker starts until it fully stops, rounded up to the nearest second.

text: Custom containers can be pulled from any compatible registry such as Docker Hub, GHCR, or Amazon ECR
quote: Custom containers: Pull from any compatible container registry such as Docker Hub, GitHub Container Registry, or Amazon ECR.

text: FlashBoot or model caching can minimize serverless worker cold-start times
quote: Minimize with FlashBoot or model caching.

text: Flex workers scale to zero when idle and use a standard per-second rate for variable workloads
quote: Flex workers | Scale to zero when idle | Standard per-second rate | Variable workloads, cost optimization

text: Secure Cloud runs on vetted infrastructure meeting SOC 2, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS compliance standards
quote: Secure Cloud provides vetted infrastructure partners who meet enterprise security standards including SOC 2, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS certifications.

text: Community Cloud connects individual compute providers to users via a vetted peer-to-peer system with competitive pricing

quote: runpodctl pod create --name NAME --gpu-id "GPU" --image "IMAGE"

text: CLI can diagnose issues and view account information in addition to managing resources
quote: You can manage Pods, Serverless endpoints, templates, network volumes, and models, transfer files between your system and Runpod, diagnose issues, and view account information.

text: Offers thousands of GPUs available across 30+ regions
quote: Thousands of GPUs across 30+ regions. Simple pricing plans for teams of all sizes, designed to scale with you.

text: REST API supports managing Pods, endpoints, templates, volumes, and registries, authenticated via API key
quote: Manage Pods, endpoints, templates, volumes, and registries through the Runpod REST API. Authenticate with Sign in with Runpod or a Runpod API key

text: Network volumes can be used to share data across multiple machines and Runpod products

text: Pods can be created, started, stopped, and terminated via console or CLI
quote: Create, start, stop, and terminate Pods using the Runpod console or CLI.

text: Supports multi-node training to handle models too large for one GPU or to accelerate training across nodes
quote: Train models too large for one GPU, or accelerate training across multiple nodes.

text: Pods are billed by the second for compute and storage with no data ingress/egress fees
quote: Pods are billed by the second for compute and storage, with no fees for data ingress or egress.

text: Runpod's CLI tool is open source
quote: Runpod CLI is an open source command-line tool for managing your Runpod resources from your local machine.
